## Plain trees nail month 1 and miss month 2 by up to 6.6%

```{=latex}
\begin{center}

\def\mbHeight{4.8cm}
\def\mbBarW{16pt}
\begin{minipage}{0.80\linewidth}
\input{figures/month-bias.tex}
\end{minipage}
\end{center}
\vspace{0.2em}
{\small Trees cannot extrapolate a rising price level; adding time $t$ still leaves June at $-7.2\%$.}
```

## The fix: log(rate / distance) = L(date) + CatBoost(x)

```{=latex}
\vspace{-1.0em}
\[
\log\frac{\text{rate}}{\text{distance}} \;=\;
\underbrace{\beta_0 + \beta_{\text{mi}}\,\bar m(d) + \beta_t\, t + \beta_{\text{qe}}\, q(d)}_{L(\text{date}):\ \text{market level, OLS}}
\;+\; \underbrace{f(\mathbf{x})}_{\text{CatBoost}}
\]
\vspace{-0.9em}
\begin{center}
\input{figures/decomposition.tex}
\end{center}
\vspace{-0.4em}
{\footnotesize $L$ = intercept + day's mean market index + linear trend + quarter-end ramp: all known in advance.\\
CatBoost takes $L$ as its baseline and learns only the lane, equipment, distance and weight structure.}
```

## Takeaways, and where they live in the code

```{=latex}
\small
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Validate the way the model is used:} forward in time, F3 scored once.
\item \textbf{Structure beat tuning:} the level decomposition took F3 MAPE from 2.35\% to 1.61\%.
\item \textbf{The learner is not the bottleneck:} TabPack was worth $\approx$ \$1, the decomposition $\approx$ \$20.
\end{itemize}
```
